title: John Harbaugh, Greg Newsome II weigh in on Giants cornerback competition

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: John Harbaugh, Greg Newsome II weigh in on Giants cornerback competition
sources.description: New York Giants head coach John Harbaugh and defensive back Greg Newsome II speak to the media about the team's position battle at cornerback with under two weeks until the team's regular season opener.
